title: 第67章 唐逸是陛下的私生子？
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: >wF半个时辰后。唐逸终于处理完柳公瑾的伤势。同时，他让牢头找来纸笔，给柳家修书一封，免得柳家人病急乱投医出问题。写完信交给唐逸，柳公瑾面色凝重道：“小逸，我是公选出来的替罪羊，想要救我太难了。”“你要记住，无论何时何地何种处境，都必须以自己的安危为第一。”“哪怕……哪怕我的案子连累到柳家，若事不可为，你不要强行阻止。”“我们，都不会怪你的。”唐逸还有妹妹要照顾，他不想让唐逸陷太深，免得没有回头路。毕竟唐敬那不当人子的，肯定不会帮他外甥的。唐逸听得鼻子一酸。“舅舅放心，我有分寸。”唐逸将信递给宁川，道：“宁头，麻烦找个兄弟替我跑一趟，现在二处的人恐怕盯死我了，我去柳家怕有变故。”“林豹。”宁川挥了挥手。一处被唐逸掏裆的青年迈着八字腿走进来，从唐逸手中接过信件，咬牙切齿道：“案子办完了，你得请老子喝酒。”“否则掏裆的事，不算完！”唐逸笑着答应，掏裆这事，的确没那么光彩。萧棣揽着牢头的肩膀，道：“牢头，想升官发财吗？想的话跟我过来，本皇子有升官发财的好事和你说说。”萧棣揽着牢头向角落里走去，一会儿又揽着牢头回来了。他脸上笑嘻嘻，一副哥俩好的样子，只是此时牢头脸色却苍白得没有半点血色。不用说，肯定被萧棣威胁了。唐逸知道萧棣是警告牢头，不准二处的人再接触柳公瑾。不然他们离开后，柳公瑾再被二处审讯，他的身体绝对熬不过一轮酷刑。这情，他领。“狱长，那就麻烦你这段时间，多多照顾一下我舅舅了。”唐逸握住牢头的手，两张百两银票便落在了牢头的手掌中。虽然有萧棣的余威，但他不能不懂事。牢头原本不敢收的，只是收了几次手，都没有收回，唐逸握得太紧了。“行，唐皇……不，唐少放心，我一定好好的照顾柳大人。”“他要出点事，你唯我是问。”唐逸怔住。唐皇？什么鬼？萧棣这王八蛋到底和这家伙说了什么？唐逸心头忽然升起浓浓的不安，看向萧棣时，却见这家伙正昂首挺胸，还朝他挤了挤眼睛。那样子似乎再说，放心，我出手，稳得很！唐逸也不好说什么，和柳公瑾告辞，一群人便出了监牢。牢头恭敬将所有人送出牢房，腿一软直接坐在了地上，全身都被冷汗湿透了。“老大，二处的人要提审柳大人，咱们根本就拦不住，你怎么答应唐逸不让柳大人受到伤害呢？”狱卒连忙走过来，将牢头扶起来。牢头抬手抹了一把脸上的冷汗，道：“拦不住也得拦，拦不住我们所有人都得死。”妈的，太吓人了，唐逸竟然是陛下的私生子！四皇子你大爷的，你告诉老子这秘密干嘛？这要是暴露了，老子会被陛下灭口的好吗！……监牢外。“小神医，你看什么时候有空，去我们太医院做客。”出了监狱，忍了很久的孙有道终于按捺不住了。唐逸想了想，道：“孙神医，等破了户部的案子吧，我舅舅还在牢狱中，户部的案子不破，我不放心。”孙有道当即看向宁川，冷着脸道：“三天内把案子破了，否则你家老爷子，就等死吧！”宁川：“？？？”这关我什么事？怎么受伤的又是我？他家老爷子这段时间病重，全靠孙有道看诊开药维持生机。要是孙有道撒手不管，老爷子恐怕撑不过半个月。“哎哟喂，老神仙，你就饶了我吧！”宁川哭丧着脸，道：“陛下限我十天内破案，如今期限只剩下六天了，我这还没半点头绪，你这让我三天破案……这不是要我的命吗？”“老神仙，不带这样玩的啊！”孙有道冷哼一声，道：“那是你的事，老夫只等结果，耽搁了老夫学习医术，你家的病以后都别找太医院。”话落，看向唐逸时又满脸笑容：“小神医，那我就在太医院，静候佳音了。”孙有道潇洒走了。宁川盯着唐逸，目光很幽怨。陛下和群臣斗法，受伤的是我。一处和二处斗法，受伤的事我。现在因为你小子和太医院的鸟事，受伤的还是我！老子是不是和你小子天生八字犯冲？“呃，宁头，这不怪我，我想要帮你说话的，但孙神医不给机会……”唐逸也很无语。孙有道一直和颜悦色，他还以为老人家脾气好呢。结果好脾气只是对他，对其他人就是一张臭脸。“少废话，问出什么没有。”宁川瞪了唐逸一眼，道：“小子，速度得快一点了，否则，你舅舅就死定了。”“苏狂公然和一处作对，和一处抢案子，不是为了证明二处比一处强。”“我要是没猜错，应该是二处得到了某个人的指令，要将你舅舅的案子做成铁案。”“所以，二处才敢明目张胆和一处打赌。”“因为目前的局面而言，他们赢定了！”唐逸心中早就有猜测，但现在听了宁川的话，他心头还是一阵发冷。这不是小打小闹的案子，这是顶级王者的巅峰赛。现在拼的是操作和水平，错一步，都会万劫不复。“宁头，我想先出一下现场。”唐逸抬头看向宁川，道：“等看完现场，咱们再细聊。”宁川点头，道：“行，那就一起出现场再说。”一群人当即出了北镇抚司。“唐逸，唐逸，看这里，看这里，我们在这里……”一道空灵的声音传来。众人齐齐循声望去，就看到不远处正停着一辆豪华马车。马车边上，一身青色长裙的萧澜，正踮着脚尖向唐逸挥手。而站在她身侧的，则是一身白色长裙宛如仙子临尘的孔诗岚。见到萧澜，所有人的目光几乎齐齐落在唐逸的身上。脑海中，不由想起之前孙神医的话。对公主又摸又亲又抱……这家伙，艳福不浅啊。唯独萧棣，牙齿已经磕得咯咯响。唐逸，老子弄死你啊！
content_en: >wFHalf an hour later.Tang Yi finally finished dealing with Liu Gongjin's injuries.At the same time, he asked the prison boss to find pen and paper and write a letter to the Liu family, so as to prevent the Liu family from going to the doctor in a hurry and causing problems.After writing the letter and handing it to Tang Yi, Liu Gongjin said with a solemn expression: "Xiao Yi, I am the scapegoat elected by the public. It is too difficult to save me." "You must remember that no matter when, where, or what the situation is, you must put your own safety first.""Even...even if my case implicates the Liu family, if it can't be done, don't stop it by force." "We won't blame you." Tang Yi still has a sister to take care of, and he doesn't want Tang Yi to sink too deep, lest there is no way back.After all, Tang Jing, who was not a son of a man, would definitely not help his nephew.Tang Yi's nose felt sore after hearing this."Uncle, don't worry, I'm sensible." Tang Yi handed the letter to Ning Chuan and said, "Ning Tou, please find a brother to run for me. People from the second office are probably keeping an eye on me now. I go to Liu's house for fear of something happening." "Lin Bao." Ning Chuan waved his hand.A young man whose crotch was picked by Tang Yi walked in with splayed legs, took the letter from Tang Yi, gritted his teeth and said: "The case is over, you have to treat me to a drink." "Otherwise, the crotch picking is not over!" Tang Yi agreed with a smile, the crotch picking was indeed not that glorious.Xiao Di held the cell leader's shoulders and said: "Prison leader, do you want to be promoted and make a fortune? If so, come with me. I will tell you about the good news of promotion and fortune." Xiao Di walked towards the corner with his arms around the prison leader, and came back after a while with his arms around the prison leader.He had a smile on his face, as if the two brothers were getting along well, but at this time, the cell leader's face was so pale that there was no color at all.Needless to say, Xiao Di must have been threatened.Tang Yi knew that Xiao Di was warning the cell leader not to allow people from the Second Division to contact Liu Gongjin again.Otherwise, after they left, Liu Gongjin would be interrogated again by the Second Division, and his body would definitely not be able to survive a round of torture.He receives this love."Warden, please take care of my uncle during this period of time." Tang Yi held the cell leader's hand, and two hundred taels of silver notes fell into the cell leader's palm.Although Xiao Di has the remaining power, he cannot be ignorant.The prison boss didn't dare to hold back at first, but he only held back his hand a few times, but he didn't take it back. Tang Yi held it too tightly."Okay, Emperor Tang... No, Don't worry, Mr. Tang, I will take good care of Mr. Liu." "If something happens to him, I'm the only one you ask." Tang Yi was stunned.Emperor Tang?What the hell?What on earth did Xiao Di, that bastard, say to this guy?Tang Yi suddenly felt uneasy. When he looked at Xiao Di, he saw this guy holding his head high and winking at him.It seems that again, don't worry, I will take action, it will be very safe!Tang Yi didn't have anything to say, so he said goodbye to Liu Gongjin, and a group of people left the prison.The cell leader respectfully sent everyone out of the cell. His legs softened and he sat directly on the ground, his whole body soaked with cold sweat."Boss, the people from the Second Division want to interrogate Mr. Liu, and we can't stop him at all. How can you promise Tang Yi not to let Mr. Liu get hurt?" The jailer quickly came over and helped the prison head up.The prison head raised his hand and wiped the cold sweat from his face, and said: "If you can't stop it, you have to stop it. If you can't stop us, all of us will die." Damn, it's so scary. Tang Yi is actually His Majesty's illegitimate son!Fourth Prince, why did you tell me this secret?If this is exposed, I will be silenced by Your Majesty, okay?...outside the prison."Little miracle doctor, when you are free, come to our hospital as a guest." After leaving the prison, Sun Youdao, who had endured it for a long time, finally couldn't hold it in any longer.Tang Yi thought for a while and said, "Mr. Sun, let's wait until the case of Hu Bu is solved. My uncle is still in prison. I won't worry if the case of Hu Bu is not solved." Sun Youdao immediately looked at Ning Chuan and said with a cold face: "Solve the case within three days, otherwise your old man will wait for death!" Ning Chuan: "???" What does this have to do with me?Why am I the one getting hurt again?His old man was seriously ill during this period, and he relied on Sun Youdao to diagnose and prescribe medicine to stay alive.If Sun Youdao lets go, the old man may not survive for half a month."Ouch, old god, just let me go!" Ning Chuan said with a sad face: "Your Majesty gave me ten days to solve the case. Now there are only six days left. I don't have a clue. You give me three days to solve the case... isn't this going to cost me my life?" "Old god, you don't do this!Sun Youdao snorted coldly and said, "That's your business. I'm just waiting for the results. It's delaying my study of medical skills. Don't go to Tai Hospital for your family's illness in the future."After saying that, he looked at Tang Yi with a smile on his face: "Little miracle doctor, I will wait for the good news at Tai Hospital."Sun Youdao left calmly.Ning Chuan stared at Tang Yi with resentful eyes.His Majesty fought with his ministers, and I was the one injured.There was a fight between the first and second places, and I was the one who got hurt.Now because of the incident between your boy and Taiyin Hospital, I am the one who is hurt!Do I have a natural conflict with your kid?"Well, Ning Tou, it's not my fault. I wanted to speak for you, but Doctor Sun didn't give you a chance..." Tang Yi was also speechless.Sun Youdao always looked kind and cheerful. He thought the old man had a good temper.As a result, his good temper was only towards him, but he had a bad temper towards others."Stop talking nonsense and ask if there's anything wrong." Ning Chuan glared at Tang Yi and said, "Boy, you have to hurry up, otherwise, your uncle will be dead." "Su Kuang openly opposed the first department and robbed the case with the first department, not to prove that the second department is better than the first." "If I guessed correctly, it should be the second department.The Division 2 got instructions from someone to make your uncle's case a solid case."That's why the Division 2 dared to make a bet with Division 1 openly.""Because of the current situation, they are sure to win!"Tang Yi had already guessed, but now he felt cold after hearing Ning Chuan's words.This is not a trivial case, this is the pinnacle match for the top kings.What matters now is operation and level. If you make one wrong step, you will be doomed."Ning Tou, I want to leave the scene first." Tang Yi looked up at Ning Chuan and said, "We will talk in detail after watching the scene." Ning Chuan nodded and said, "Okay, then we will show up together." A group of people immediately left Beizhen Fusi."Tang Yi, Tang Yi, look here, look here, we are here..." came an ethereal voice.Everyone looked up and saw a luxury carriage parked not far away.Beside the carriage, Xiao Lan, who was wearing a long green dress, was standing on tiptoes and waving to Tang Yi.Standing next to her was Kong Shilan, who looked like a fairy in a long white dress.Seeing Xiao Lan, everyone's eyes almost fell on Tang Yi.in mind
title_en: Chapter 67 Tang Yi is His Majesty’s illegitimate son?
